introHtml: Hanes wine carriers totes combine the trusted quality of Hanes apparel with a practical design for transporting wine bottles. Made from durable cotton or cotton-blend fabrics, these totes offer a comfortable grip and a roomy interior. Perfect for corporate gifts, trade shows, or retail promotions, they provide a large imprint area for your logo or message. Choose from full-color or one-color screen printing to match your brand.
